title: if with a short statement
hints: An if can begin with a short statement: if v, err := f(); err != nil { … } else { … }. Variables declared there are visible in every branch, but not after the if.
strconv.Atoi(s) converts text to an int and returns a non-nil error when the text isn't a number. strings.TrimSpace removes surrounding whitespace.
if n, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(s)); err != nil { return "not a number" } else if n < 0 { return "negative" } else if n == 0 { return "zero" } else { return "positive" }
